items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because, now, one of the best rhythm sections was when Earl Hines had Alvin Burroughs. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Mm hmm.

ctx.x: Where did Earl Warren go when he left? Now you've got Preston Love and George Dorsey on altos.
Warren -- did he come back? Did Earl come back?
Earl came back, I think -- yeah. But, Preston Love was in there for quite a while.
